summary: NX-OS supports CLI over SSH (network_cli) with enable via become since 2.5.3, and NX-API over HTTP(S) (httpapi) via web proxy without enable mode; outputs are stdout[0] and stdout[0].messages[0], and local is deprecated.
questions: Should I use CLI or NX-API for Nexus switches?
How do I use enable mode on NX-OS?

answer_card.title: Cisco NX-OS connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
| | CLI | NX-API |
|---|---|---|
| Protocol | SSH | HTTP(S) |
| Credentials | SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k` | HTTPS certificates if present |
| Indirect access | bastion | web proxy |
| `ansible_connection` | `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | `ansible.netcommon.httpapi` |
| Enable mode | `ansible_become: true`, `become_method: enable`, `become_password` (since 2.5.3) | not supported |
| Output | `stdout[0].` | `stdout[0].messages[0].` |

`ansible_connection: local` is deprecated.
